def main():
    mod = 1000000007
    n = int(input().strip())
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if j != i:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i][j - 1]) % mod
            if i != 0:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j]) % mod
    result = 0
    for j in range(n, -1, -1):
        for i in range(j - 1, -1, -2):
            result += dp[i][j]
            result %= mod
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
